name: go-cli
description: > Build command-line tools in Go: flag handling, subcommands, stdin/stdout discipline, exit codes, signal handling, and when Cobra/Viper earn their weight over the standard library. Use when: "build a CLI", "add a subcommand", "parse flags", "exit codes", "handle Ctrl+C", "cobra command", "read from stdin", "CLI UX". Not for: HTTP APIs (go-api-design), scaffolding (go-project-layout), service configuration (go-architecture-review).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套用 Go 构建命令行工具的实践指南，涵盖参数解析、子命令、输入输出、退出码和 Ctrl+C 处理，适合开发 CLI。
